lessons_used: Predictions were generally too optimistic overall, though select winning tests (such as sign_in redesign in round 6 and choose_path redesign in round 10) were underpredicted.
Sign_in hint changes were helpful, winning 2 of 7 tests, while the remaining 5 tests showed no clear effect.
Home wait_info changes (5 tests) and adoption layout changes (3 tests) showed no clear effect.
Finish redesign changes (4 tests) and finish new_screen changes (3 tests) showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Adoption redesign changes (4 tests) showed no clear effect or hurt performance.

Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for categories with single tests or conflicting outcomes (such as home notification, adoption new_flow, choose_path layout, choose_path redesign, and sign_in redesign).

candidates.title: Compact Layout Adoption Certificate Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a compact layout to streamline pet naming and final confirmation.
candidates.why: Adoption step dropoff is severe with only 63.8% completion and a long median duration of 89s. A compact layout reduces friction before waiting.

adoption_certificate.headline: Finalize Your Companion's Adoption
adoption_certificate.body: Name your desktop pet and issue its certificate to complete setup.

guard.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate into a compact layout retains the step and screen job without violating base rules.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step drops 36.2%, but adoption redesigns historically hurt performance (-3.5%).

candidates.title: Two Column Sign In Protection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen into a two-column layout that clearly presents account sign-in alongside pet sync protection details.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in. Presenting account benefits cleanly in two columns reassures returning and new users.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect Your Desktop Companion
sign_in.body: Signing in ensures your pet state, memories, and custom visuals remain synced across sessions.

guard.reason: Two-column layout redesign for sign-in keeps the sign-in step intact and provides clear account protection context.

candidates.score_note: Strong support email evidence, but sign_in redesigns average negative lift (-1.2%).

candidates.title: Checklist Layout Home Intro Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the final onboarding home intro screen with a checklist layout outlining key desktop interactions.
candidates.why: Finish completion drops to 68.0% and users report confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Pet is Ready!
home_intro.body: Review the quick start checklist below to interact with and summon your pet anytime.

guard.reason: Checklist layout redesign for the home intro screen stays within onboarding and maintains required functionality.

candidates.score_note: Finish dropoff is high, but past finish redesigns failed to improve or hurt metrics (-2.9%).

candidates.title: Spotlight Layout Waiting Screen Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen using a spotlight layout focused on active background companion preparation status.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a high median time of 201s and mean of 2336s. A spotlight layout gives visual prominence to process updates.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet Desktop Workspace
waiting.body: We are generating your desktop companion files and configuring background permissions.

guard.reason: Spotlight layout redesign for the waiting screen clearly shows background companion preparation status.

candidates.score_note: High wait time, but home redesign/layout changes show no clear positive trend.

candidates.title: Companion Personality Trait Selection Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new personality trait selection screen right after pick_friend to let users customize companion behavior.
candidates.why: Adoption has the highest funnel dropoff (63.8%). Adding engaging personality trait selection increases emotional investment prior to photo upload and certification.

new_personality_traits.headline: Choose Your Pet's Personality
new_personality_traits.body: Select how playful or quiet your pet should be on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a new personality trait selection screen inside onboarding flow is allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: High dropoff at adoption step, but extra new screens strongly hurt conversion (-7.8%).

candidates.title: Clear Path Selection Direct Headline Copy
candidates.change: Update headline and body on choose_path screen to state choices explicitly without abstract narrative language.
candidates.why: Choose path has a high mean duration of 514s, indicating initial user hesitation when selecting between standard pets and custom generation.

choose_path.headline: Choose How You Want to Create Your Pet
choose_path.body: Select a ready-to-use pet or upload photos to generate a unique custom companion.

candidates.title: Account Preservation Sign In Safety Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit safety hint below the sign in form confirming pet progress is saved automatically.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails mentioned concerns or bugs regarding lost pet progress when signing in.

sign_in.hint: Your pet customization and adoption progress will be linked directly to this account.

guard.reason: Adding a safety hint to the sign-in screen is a permitted onboarding copy update.

candidates.score_note: Supported by emails; sign_in hints are one of the few historically winning categories (+1.9%).

candidates.title: Custom Pet Fast Generation Seal Incentive
candidates.change: Display a quality guarantee badge on the adoption certificate screen reassuring users of successful rendering.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets highlighted custom pet creation failures, causing dropoff during adoption.

guard.reason: Adding a quality guarantee badge on the adoption certificate does not violate pricing or dark pattern rules.

candidates.score_note: Clear user complaint evidence, but adoption incentive historically performed poorly (-8.6%).

candidates.title: Desktop Engine Initialization Status Wait Info
candidates.change: Enable progress bar and hint text detailing system tray and rendering initialization during the wait step.
candidates.why: Users report app stalling or pet missing on desktop (3 emails) during the long home waiting phase (median 201s).

waiting.hint: Initializing local desktop renderer and setting up system tray shortcut...

guard.reason: Enabling progress bar and status text on the waiting screen accurately reflects the real pet preparation step.

candidates.score_note: Addresses support emails during long wait time; wait_info historically yields modest positive (+0.3%).

candidates.title: Desktop Control Shortcut Home Notification
candidates.change: Enable ready notification toggle and add control tip component on home intro screen.
candidates.why: Support receives frequent post-onboarding confusion tickets about how to hide, control, or summon the desktop companion.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Press your hotkey or right-click the system tray icon to hide or interact with your pet.

guard.reason: Adding a ready notification toggle and control tip to home_intro is an allowed onboarding modification.

candidates.score_note: Addresses post-onboarding confusion, but notification changes historically show neutral/negative effect (-0.3%).
